summary: community.crypto will require every CryptoBackend implementation to override get_ordered_csr_identifiers(), and the default implementation that sorts get_csr_identifiers() will be removed.
questions: Do I need to implement get_ordered_csr_identifiers in my CryptoBackend?
Is the default get_ordered_csr_identifiers going away?

answer_card.title: CryptoBackend must override get_ordered_csr_identifiers
answer_card.answer_md: Custom `acme.backends` **`CryptoBackend`** implementations must override **`get_ordered_csr_identifiers()`**. The default (which just sorts `get_csr_identifiers()`) will be removed.
